description: This file defines a static class containing constants used for JavaScript interop in a Blazor application, specifically for cookie management and UI behavior control.

classes.name: JSInteropConstants
classes.description: A static class containing string constants for JavaScript interop function names.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript function name for deleting cookies.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript function name for retrieving cookies.

methods.name: RouteOutside
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript function name for routing outside the application.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript function name for hiding body overflow.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript function name for showing body overflow.
